title: HB1388 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to the carrying of weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2021-02-22; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2304274)
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2021-02-22 (HB 1388 / SB 1391). Rewrites 39-17-1307 and deletes 39-17-1308, which removes the offense of carrying a firearm or club with intent to go armed and its defenses; keeps the offenses for felons, domestic-violence and protection-order subjects and others barred. Effective July 1, 2021. Section 3 is a severability clause.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (1) A person commits an offense who possesses a firearm; and:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (A) Has been convicted of a felony crime of violence, an attempt to commit a felony crime of violence, or a felony involving use of a deadly weapon; or
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (B) Has been convicted of a felony drug offense.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(b)): (1) A person commits an offense who possesses a handgun and has been convicted of a felony unless:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(d)): (1) A person commits an offense who possesses a firearm and:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(d)): (4) For purposes of this section, a person does not possess a firearm, including, but not limited to, firearms registered under the National Firearms Act (26 U.S.C. § 5801 et seq.), if the firearm is in a safe or similar container that is securely locked and to which the person does not have the combination, keys, or other means of normal access.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1308): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1308, is amended by deleting the section.
